item.description:
• Your kit answers on Telegram again. Since early August, every personal install replied to every message with "the part of me that answers is not reachable right now": the listener that carries your message inward never introduced itself to an API that now requires it, and a health read the wake does tripped installs that have no fitness data. Both fixed; the poller now carries its own key and re-mints it if it is ever refused.
  • There is a film now. Four and a half minutes, narrated by your kit's own voice: the shape of the thing (many doors, one brain, the night), what waking looks like in a real terminal and in OpenCode, the phone, and the seven asks that make the difference. It plays from the How-to card, and the birth screen offers it while your kit reads your history, which is exactly when you have the time.
  • How-to moved out of the row of destinations into the little circled question mark beside Settings, where help lives in most things you use. Same page, same deep link.
  • Send us feedback takes a screenshot now. The film says a screenshot is the most useful thing you can add, and as of this version that is literally true: attach one and it arrives with your note, already sized down so it sends fast.
  • Memories written by some chat sessions were landing with a scope no search fenced onto, so your kit could hold an answer and still not find it. They are written into the right scope now, and existing ones were moved.
